groups.name: console
groups.summary: Read the captured Editor console (filter by level, regex and time) or clear it.

actions.name: get
actions.summary: Read console entries. Paged, newest-last, with a bounded default page size.

actions.name: clear
actions.summary: Append a clear marker so every earlier entry is treated as cleared.

types.description: Alias of 'level' (MCP naming); 'all' expands to log/warning/error/assert/exception.

count.description: Upper bound for one response; used as the page size unless pageSize is given.

cursor.description: Opaque paging cursor from the previous response, or a plain offset.

grep.description: Regular expression matched against message and stack trace.

since.description: ISO-8601 time; entries older than this are dropped.

groups.name: editor
groups.summary: Inspect and control the Editor: state, Play Mode, menu items, undo/redo, tool, tags, layers, selection.

actions.name: state
actions.summary: Report project identity, compile/import/Play Mode flags, open scenes and worker session.

actions.name: ping
actions.summary: Round-trip liveness probe; the cheapest way to prove the queue is wired up.

actions.name: play
actions.summary: Enter Play Mode.

actions.name: stop
actions.summary: Leave Play Mode.

actions.name: pause
actions.summary: Toggle pause. Only valid in Play Mode.

actions.name: step
actions.summary: Advance one frame. Only valid while paused in Play Mode.

actions.name: menu
actions.summary: Execute a menu item by its exact path, e.g. 'GameObject/Create Empty'.

actions.name: undo
actions.summary: Perform one Undo.

actions.name: redo
actions.summary: Perform one Redo.

actions.name: tool
actions.summary: Set the active Scene view tool.

actions.name: tool-list
actions.summary: List the available Scene view tools.

actions.name: tag-list
actions.summary: List every project tag.

actions.name: tag-add
actions.summary: Create a project tag.

actions.name: tag-remove
actions.summary: Delete a project tag.

actions.name: layer-list
actions.summary: List all 32 layers, marking the built-in ones.

actions.name: layer-add
actions.summary: Create a user layer in the first free slot (8-31).

actions.name: layer-remove
actions.summary: Clear a user layer. Built-in layers cannot be removed.

actions.name: selection-get
actions.summary: Report the current selection.

actions.name: selection-set
actions.summary: Replace the selection with resolved objects.

tool.description: action=tool: View, Move, Rotate, Rect, Scale, Custom, None.

target.description: action=selection-set: name, hierarchy path or instance id.

groups.name: meta
groups.summary: Inspect and refresh the command surface itself: export the static registry, scaffold project-local commands, report the worker environment.

actions.name: doctor
actions.summary: Worker-side environment report: command diagnostics, optional packages, versions.

actions.name: export-registry
actions.summary: Regenerate the shipped commands/registry.json from the compiled package commands only.

actions.name: catalog
actions.summary: Dump the runtime command catalog exactly as published to Library/CustomUnityCli.

actions.name: schema
actions.summary: Return the parameter JSON schema of one command group.

actions.name: extensions
actions.summary: Report the project-local extension area and the commands it contributes.

actions.name: new-command
actions.summary: Scaffold a new project-local command group in the extension area.

actions.name: verify
actions.summary: Self-check: validate the extension area and every command's action list against its JSON schema.

actions.name: environment
actions.summary: Report Unity, platform, package versions and the optional-package probe results.

path.description: action=export-registry: destination for registry.json. Relative paths resolve against the project root.

group.description: action=schema / new-command: group name, e.g. object.

summary.description: action=new-command: one-line description of the group.

actionNames.description: action=new-command: sub-action names to scaffold. Defaults to a single 'run' action.

actionName.description: action=new-command: a single sub-action to scaffold, as an alternative to actionNames. Note that the bare name 'action' is reserved by the CLI as the group action selector.

namespace.description: action=new-command: C# namespace for the generated file.

groups.name: refresh
groups.summary: Refresh assets, trigger or await script compilation, reimport specific paths, and wait for the Editor to become idle.

actions.name: assets
actions.summary: Rescan the asset database (AssetDatabase.Refresh).

actions.name: compile
actions.summary: Request script compilation and, by default, wait until it finishes.

actions.name: reimport
actions.summary: Force-reimport specific asset paths.

actions.name: wait
actions.summary: Block until the Editor is idle: not compiling and not importing.

actions.name: status
actions.summary: Report compile/import state and the first compilation error, if any.

wait.description: action=compile: wait for compilation to finish.

requireCompileSuccess.description: action=wait: fail if the last compilation had errors.

groups.name: selftest
groups.summary: Test the tool itself: echo a payload back, verify the shared helpers, and classify every registered action.

actions.name: core
actions.summary: Run assertions over the shared helper layer (args, values, describe, paging, reflection, serialized, assets, paths, json).

actions.name: echo
actions.summary: Return the payload unchanged plus a token, to prove end-to-end fidelity through the queue.

actions.name: surface
actions.summary: Classify every registered action as read-only, mutating or destructive, with its safety metadata.

actions.name: sample
actions.summary: Produce a compact overview: group and action counts, helper check summary, optional package availability.

token.description: action=echo: arbitrary token echoed back verbatim.

mutate.description: Allow the few checks that must write (a temporary folder, runtime scratch files).

group.description: action=surface: restrict the plan to one group.

verbose.description: Include a detail line for every passing check.

groups.name: test
groups.summary: Unity Test Framework: start an EditMode or PlayMode run, poll its progress and failures, read the results.

actions.name: status
actions.summary: Poll a test job by jobId: progress, stuck detection and the first failures.

actions.name: run
actions.summary: Start a test run. Returns jobId immediately; at most one job runs at a time.

actions.name: result
actions.summary: Read the finished summary and the individual test cases (paged).

actions.name: list
actions.summary: List the retained test jobs (at most 10). Paged.

actions.name: cancel
actions.summary: Mark the current test job as cancelled (Unity cannot abort a run in flight).

includeFailedTests.description: Return only the cases that did not pass.

clearStuck.description: action=run: clear the stuck job instead of starting one.
